description: This Java class represents an immutable event named AttributesDeleted, emitted after a Thing's attributes are deleted in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods for constructing instances, serializing/deserializing to/from JSON, and managing event metadata and resource path.

classes.name: AttributesDeleted
classes.description: An immutable Java class representing the 'attributesDeleted' event in the Eclipse Ditto framework, used to signal that a thing's attributes were deleted.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an AttributesDeleted instance with detailed parameters including thing ID, revision, timestamp, headers, and metadata.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to deserialize an AttributesDeleted object from JSON string or JSON object, with associated headers.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path associated with this event resource.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified revision, preserving other properties.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified Ditto headers, preserving other properties.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Internally used to append payload data to a JSON object builder; no payload for this event.
